newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps unchanged in slow Friday market.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps unchanged in slow Friday market.

text.p: European oil swaps were barely changed on Friday as the markets trundled slowly into the weekend.
Brent CFDs were a few cents stronger and front-month naphtha put on $1 or so. Fuel swaps were steady as were gasoline swaps after recent pushes higher.
Traders said business was quiet ahead of the weekend amid a lack of fresh news capable of moving the market significantly one way or the other.
Brent CFDs were pegged around +12/13 cents against September Brent for July 28-August 1 from +9 cents while August 4-8 held at -5 cents.
August 11-15 was unchanged at -11 cents and August 18-22 drifted sideways around -13 cents.
Heavy fuel swaps were steady around $90 for August with September in contango by $1.00 and October by $1.50. Physical barge business was muted, but $89.50 fob was done.
Gasoline, the driver for the energy complex earlier in the week, was taking a breather with August holding around $195.50 with September in backwardation to $189 with October down at $184.
Naphtha swaps were also flat with August ranged at about $186.50 with September $2 in backwardation and flat against October.
Gas oil crack spread were seen around $4.30 for 4Q, $4.40 for 1Q98 and $4.00 for 2Q98.
